title: Artifact for: Retrospective Auditing of Cross-Organizational Processes with Zero-Knowledge Proofs
description: Prototype (RISC Zero 3.0.6, CPU prover), reference model and measurement scripts for the TDK paper 'Retrospective Auditing of Cross-Organizational Processes with Zero-Knowledge Proofs': the guest program, prover host, auditor, aggregation guest, acceptance tests, evaluation scripts and the raw results behind Chapter 6.
